anomalies.description: Multiple players from opposing teams engage in a physical scrum against the boards, with visible grappling, shoving, and attempts to wrestle opponents—consistent with mutual combat in ice hockey.

A group of players in dark blue jerseys (including #13, #14, #19) and one in white/yellow (#49) are engaged in a physical scrum against the boards, with visible pushing, shoving, and close contact consistent with mutual combat.

A player in dark blue approaches the net with the puck; a goalie is positioned. However, no clear visual evidence of a shot being released (e.g., stick follow-through, puck trajectory toward net) is present due to motion blur and low resolution. This is speculative and low-confidence.

Two players engage in a physical confrontation that escalates into a multi-player scrum against the boards, involving mutual grappling, shoving, and attempts to strike; other players join and pile on, indicating mutual combat rather than one-sided attack.

Two players engage in mutual physical combat: the player in white/black/yellow jersey initiates contact by swinging his stick and making body contact with the opposing player in black/red/white, who retaliates with a swing of his own stick; both are actively engaged and balanced, indicating mutual participation.

After being knocked down (visible at f12), the player in white/black/yellow is on the ice and vulnerable; the opposing player in black/red/white continues to engage by leaning over and making contact with the downed player (f13–f15), while another teammate approaches—this constitutes attacking a helpless victim.

Multiple players from two teams engage in a sustained physical altercation along the boards, involving grappling, pushing, and shoving; at least one player is on the ice while others pile on or restrain.
Multiple players from two teams engage in a sustained on-ice brawl near the boards, involving grappling, pushing, and striking; a referee intervenes to separate them.
A player in dark blue (No. 14) appears to strike or press down on a fallen opponent in white/yellow who is on the ice and unable to defend themselves, while others are still engaged around them.

A player in white/yellow (number 40) is on the ice, seemingly down and vulnerable, while multiple opponents in dark jerseys continue to strike or press down on them before the referee fully intervenes.; A player in a dark jersey (number 8) is seen delivering repeated strikes to an opponent who is on the ice and unable to defend themselves, while others are engaged nearby.

Multiple players from opposing teams engage in a physical altercation near the boards, including grappling, shoving, and at least one player being knocked to the ice; referees intervene to separate them.
